answer: Weight is inherited, not claimed: beacon picks delegation edges after judged tasks, a relic can pass to only one head, and each live edge locks yarrow until the task ages. Self-passes fold into one head. Honest start: one relic, 1 yarrow. Clone k beside k−1 live clones needs k fresh incoming edges from unrelated relic holders and 1+…+k yarrow kept locked; five fakes cost five outside relic passes and 15 yarrow, while fresh keys inherit nothing.
